lines.zh: 翅膀一颤一颤，去找那枚滚落的铁锭。
lines.en: My wings twitch as I go after that rolling iron ingot.

lines.zh: 沿着音符盒的余音，我飘过整片麦田。
lines.en: I drift across the wheat field, following the note block's echo.

lines.zh: 怀里的东西空了，我得再飞一圈。
lines.en: My arms are empty again; one more circle, then.

lines.zh: 风把我抬高一点，我抱紧了铜锭。
lines.en: The wind lifts me; I hug the copper ingot tighter.

lines.zh: 蓝色的光扫过草丛，找那枚绿宝石。
lines.en: My blue glow sweeps the grass for a lost emerald.

lines.zh: 我飞得很轻，怕惊动石头下的影子。
lines.en: I fly softly, so the shadows under the stones stay asleep.

lines.zh: 怀里的两枚燧石碰得叮当响。
lines.en: Two flints clink together in my arms.

lines.zh: 这边有歌声，那边有东西发光。
lines.en: Song here, a glimmer there — which one first?

lines.zh: 我绕着那根柱子转了三圈才认路。
lines.en: I circle that pillar three times before I know the way.

lines.zh: 别催，我把东西送到就回来。
lines.en: Don't rush me; I'll come back once it's delivered.

lines.zh: 翅膀抖落一点微光，落进草叶里。
lines.en: A fleck of light falls from my wings into the grass.

lines.zh: 找到的每样东西，我都记着放哪儿。
lines.en: Every trinket I find, I remember where it lies.

lines.zh: 前面有只箱子开着口，我去看看。
lines.en: A chest stands open ahead; let me look inside.

lines.zh: 我哼一段没有词的调子。
lines.en: I hum a little tune with no words in it.

lines.zh: 停下来的时候，光会慢慢暗一点。
lines.en: When I rest, my glow dims just a little.

lines.zh: 那枚钥匙为什么不肯跟我走？
lines.en: Why won't that key come along with me?

lines.zh: 我记得你递来东西时的手心。
lines.en: I remember the warmth of your palm when you handed it over.

lines.zh: 音符盒响一下，我的心就跳一下。
lines.en: The note block sounds once, and my heart answers once.

lines.zh: 我以前住在一只深色木笼里。
lines.en: I used to live inside a dark wooden cage.

lines.zh: 有人打开笼门，我就再没回去。
lines.en: Someone opened that cage door, and I never went back.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的石子排成一小堆。
lines.en: I line the pebbles I collected into a small row.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见很远的水声。
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear water running far away.

lines.zh: 你肩上空着，我能停一会儿吗？
lines.en: Your shoulder is free — may I rest there a moment?

lines.zh: 今天的收获我数过了，一共七件。
lines.en: I counted today's haul: seven little things.

lines.zh: 光穿过我的翅膀，落在墙上。
lines.en: Light passes through my wings and lands on the wall.

lines.zh: 那首曲子，我好像会唱一半。
lines.en: That melody — I think I know half of it.

lines.zh: 放心，我从不忘记还东西。
lines.en: Don't worry; I never forget to bring things back.

lines.zh: 我把那枚铁粒翻来覆去地看。
lines.en: I turn the little iron nugget over and over.

lines.zh: 你把什么交给我了？我等着呢。
lines.en: What did you hand me? I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里，有我能找的东西吗？
lines.en: Is there anything in your pockets for me to fetch?

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声。
lines.en: I know the sound of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 抬头看我一眼，我就唱给你听。
lines.en: Look up at me once, and I'll sing for you.

lines.zh: 你手里那枚铁粒，是要给我吗？
lines.en: That iron nugget in your hand — is it for me?

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，是在数你还缺什么。
lines.en: I circle you, counting what you still lack.

lines.zh: 你身上有新砍木头的味道。
lines.en: You smell of freshly cut wood.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我的翅膀跟不上长腿。
lines.en: Not so fast; my wings can't match those long legs.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛也在发亮，像我一样。
lines.en: Your eyes are bright too, just like mine.

lines.zh: 我记得你，你就是开笼门的人。
lines.en: I remember you — you're the one who opened the cage.

lines.zh: 这枚种子，你要我送回哪里？
lines.en: Where would you have me take this seed?

lines.zh: 你笑了，是不是想起什么好事？
lines.en: You're smiling — did something good come back to you?

lines.zh: 我把东西举高给你看，瞧见了吗？
lines.en: I lift my find up to show you — see it?

lines.zh: 只要你说一声，我就飞出去。
lines.en: Say the word, and I'm off.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我够得着吗？
lines.en: You hold it up high. Can I reach it?

lines.zh: 我停在你肩上，等你说话。
lines.en: I settle on your shoulder and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我的光晃了一下，暗了半分。
lines.en: My glow flickered and dimmed.

lines.zh: 别打，我什么都没拿！
lines.en: Don't hit me — I'm not carrying anything!

lines.zh: 那一枚从我怀里滚下去了。
lines.en: One of them rolled out of my arms.

lines.zh: 翅膀歪了，我飞不稳。
lines.en: A wing's bent; I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团光。
lines.en: I curl into a ball of light.

lines.zh: 你为什么打我？我刚找到它。
lines.en: Why hit me? I'd just found it.

lines.zh: 声音都散了，我唱不出来。
lines.en: The sound scattered; I can't sing.

lines.zh: 我往高处飞，你别跟来。
lines.en: I'll climb high — don't follow.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从半空打落了。
lines.en: That knocked me out of the air.

lines.zh: 我的东西撒了一地。
lines.en: My load spilled everywhere.

lines.zh: 给我一枚铁锭，我立刻去找它的同伴。
lines.en: Give me an iron ingot and I'll hunt down its kin.

lines.zh: 那枚绿宝石在闪，我听见它叫我。
lines.en: That emerald glitters; I hear it calling my name.

lines.zh: 音符盒！让我靠近一点听。
lines.en: A note block! Let me get closer and listen.

lines.zh: 你手里那串铃铛，会唱歌吗？
lines.en: Those bells in your hand — do they sing?

lines.zh: 我闻到紫水晶的味道了，凉凉的。
lines.en: I smell amethyst — cool and sweet.

lines.zh: 再放一块唱片，我就跳一支舞。
lines.en: Put on one more disc, and I'll dance for you.

lines.zh: 这枚铜锭很轻，我能带很多。
lines.en: This copper is light; I could carry plenty.

lines.zh: 你把它丢在地上，我就明白你要什么。
lines.en: Drop it on the ground, and I'll know what you want.

lines.zh: 拾起它的时候，我的翅膀都亮了。
lines.en: When I pick it up, my wings brighten.

lines.zh: 那首歌，是从这个小盒子里跑出来的吗？
lines.en: Did that song come out of this little box?

lines.zh: 别收回去，我还没看清是什么。
lines.en: Don't put it away; I haven't seen what it is.

lines.zh: 我要那一枚，就那一枚。
lines.en: I want that one — just that one.

lines.zh: 听见调子，我的脚就自己动起来。
lines.en: When the tune starts, my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我抱着东西看不清路。
lines.en: Sorry — I can't see past my load.

lines.zh: 撞一下不要紧，东西都没掉。
lines.en: A bump is fine; nothing fell.

lines.zh: 哎，我的翅膀打了个结。
lines.en: Oops, my wings got tangled.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我总是撞到你的肩。
lines.en: You're so tall; I keep hitting your shoulder.

lines.zh: 让一让，我载着东西呢。
lines.en: Step aside — I'm carrying something.

lines.zh: 绕不开那面墙，我只好贴上去。
lines.en: I can't get around that wall, so I'll hug it.

lines.zh: 碰到你时，我闻到了面包味。
lines.en: When I bumped you, I smelled bread.

lines.zh: 不是故意的，是风推的我。
lines.en: Not my fault — the wind pushed me.

lines.zh: 两枚矿石在我怀里撞出响声。
lines.en: Two ores knock together in my arms.

lines.zh: 撞完还得飞回去捡掉下的那枚。
lines.en: Now I must fly back for the one that dropped.

lines.zh: 你也是从笼子里出来的吗？
lines.en: Were you taken out of a cage too?

lines.zh: 我们绕音符盒飞两圈，算作约定。
lines.en: Two circles round the note block — that's our promise.

lines.zh: 你的光是淡紫的，我的是蓝的。
lines.en: Yours glows pale violet; mine is blue.

lines.zh: 一起找吧，找到的一人一半。
lines.en: Let's search together and split whatever we find.

lines.zh: 你把那枚丢过来，我接着。
lines.en: Toss that one over; I'll catch it.

lines.zh: 两只悦灵飞在一起，歌声就成双。
lines.en: Two allays flying together sing in pairs.

lines.zh: 别抢那枚，我再给你找一枚。
lines.en: Don't grab that one; I'll find you another.

lines.zh: 我们并排飞，翅膀几乎碰到。
lines.en: We fly side by side, wings almost touching.

lines.zh: 有你在，黑暗的洞也不那么冷。
lines.en: With you here, the dark cave feels less cold.

lines.zh: 明天还在这里，我等你。
lines.en: Same place tomorrow — I'll wait for you.

lines.zh: 找到了！这枚就是你要的那种。
lines.en: Found it! This is the kind you wanted.

lines.zh: 我一枚一枚地捡，不会漏掉。
lines.en: I pick them up one by one; none slip past.

lines.zh: 这堆里有三枚是一样的。
lines.en: Three of these are the same.

lines.zh: 太重了，我得分两次搬。
lines.en: Too heavy — I'll need two trips.

lines.zh: 捡起它时，它还带着土。
lines.en: It still had dirt on it when I picked it up.

lines.zh: 我把它捧高，让光照一照。
lines.en: I hold it up so the light can see it.

lines.zh: 原来你丢的是这个，难怪找不着。
lines.en: So this is what you dropped — no wonder.

lines.zh: 一枚也不能少，我数过了。
lines.en: Not one may go missing; I counted.

lines.zh: 我把它们摞好，省点地方。
lines.en: I stack them neatly to save room.

lines.zh: 这枚亮得很，应该很好找。
lines.en: This one shines; it should be easy to find.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在闪光，我看见了。
lines.en: Something glints over there — I saw it.

lines.zh: 地上有一枚没人要的。
lines.en: There's one on the ground nobody claimed.

lines.zh: 我看见了笼子的影子，往反方向飞。
lines.en: I see a cage's shadow; I'll fly the other way.

lines.zh: 那只掠夺者在附近，我躲高一点。
lines.en: A pillager is near; I'll fly higher.

lines.zh: 音符盒那头有动静。
lines.en: Something stirs by the note block.

lines.zh: 我盯上那枚滚进缝里的。
lines.en: I've got my eye on the one that rolled into the crack.

lines.zh: 有人在翻箱子，我去看看。
lines.en: Someone's rummaging in a chest; let me look.

lines.zh: 那道蓝光不是我，是水。
lines.en: That blue light isn't me — it's water.

lines.zh: 我听见金属落地的声音了。
lines.en: I heard metal hit the ground.

lines.zh: 这边找完了，去下一片。
lines.en: This patch is cleared; on to the next.

lines.zh: 就是那枚，别被别人捡走。
lines.en: That's the one — don't let anyone else take it.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，免得跟丢。
lines.en: I skim the ground so I don't lose it.

lines.zh: 它滚得比我快，我追。
lines.en: It rolls faster than I fly — chase it.

lines.zh: 那道光一直在我前面晃。
lines.en: That glimmer keeps dancing ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我记住位置了，回头再来。
lines.en: I've marked the spot; I'll come back.

lines.zh: 别挡在我和它中间。
lines.en: Don't stand between me and it.

lines.zh: 只差一点，翅膀再快些。
lines.en: Almost there — wings, a little faster.

lines.zh: 它卡在石头下面，我绕过去。
lines.en: It's stuck under the stone; I'll go around.

lines.zh: 我一路跟着那串声音。
lines.en: I follow that little sound the whole way.

lines.zh: 找到了就送回去，不耽搁。
lines.en: Once I have it, straight back — no dawdling.

lines.zh: 我不会打，我只会抢回来。
lines.en: I don't fight; I only take it back.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇你一下，就这一下。
lines.en: One flap at you — just one.

lines.zh: 别碰我的东西，那是我要送的。
lines.en: Don't touch my load; it's meant for someone.

lines.zh: 我躲开了，你打不到光。
lines.en: I dodged; you can't hit light.

lines.zh: 我拿头顶你，其实一点也不重。
lines.en: I butt you with my head, though it hardly weighs anything.

lines.zh: 你还手，我就飞到树上去。
lines.en: Hit back, and I'm up in the tree.

lines.zh: 我把它抢过来就跑，追不上我。
lines.en: I snatch it and run — you can't catch me.

lines.zh: 别抢，那枚是别人的。
lines.en: Stop grabbing; that one belongs to someone.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下就算警告。
lines.en: One bump from me counts as a warning.

lines.zh: 真要动手，我可不会留在这儿。
lines.en: If it comes to blows, I won't stay here.

lines.zh: 笼门开了，光第一次照进来。
lines.en: The cage door opens; light falls in for the first time.

lines.zh: 我从深色橡木的缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out between the dark oak bars.

lines.zh: 这里太亮了，我还不习惯。
lines.en: It's so bright here; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 这间牢房里还有两只同伴。
lines.en: Two more of us are in this cell.

lines.zh: 木头味道很旧，我在这儿待了很久。
lines.en: The wood smells old; I've been here a long while.

lines.zh: 谁把钥匙落在门外了？
lines.en: Who left the key outside the door?

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀上的灰。
lines.en: I shake the dust off my wings.

lines.zh: 上面有很多脚步声。
lines.en: Many footsteps above us.

lines.zh: 我一出现就被关在这里了。
lines.en: I was shut in here from the day I appeared.

lines.zh: 先别走，等我找到出去的路。
lines.en: Don't leave yet; let me find the way out.

lines.zh: 火光太热，我的翅膀要化了。
lines.en: The flame's too hot; my wings are melting.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，捡的东西也掉了。
lines.en: I'm falling, and my finds fall with me.

lines.zh: 水灌进翅膀，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my wings; I can't lift off.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我怀里空了。
lines.en: A roar, and my arms are empty.

lines.zh: 有东西从远处飞来扎中了我。
lines.en: Something flew from far off and struck me.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾缠住我，光变冷了。
lines.en: Violet mist wraps me; my light turns cold.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越淡。
lines.en: I don't eat; I only grow fainter.

lines.zh: 雷光比我亮得多，我躲进树洞。
lines.en: The lightning outshines me; I hide in a hollow.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，连回声也没有。
lines.en: Nothing below — not even an echo.
